issues.where: the far rim of the crater, crop x 83 to 100%, y 25 to 42%
issues.what: the flat water plane cuts across the top of the cliff on a jagged, broken line, so a geometry seam shows where the lake meets the rock
issues.fix: blend the water into the rim, add a wet edge or crust line, and clean the intersection

issues.where: the carcass on the bench, crop x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%
issues.what: the carcass reads as a crumpled cloth or plastic sheet with a stretched, smeared texture and no bone or skin structure under it
issues.fix: model real collapsed anatomy with bone points and sunken hide, and use a carcass texture at the right scale

issues.where: the near shore slabs and water, crop x 0 to 17%, y 58 to 75%
issues.what: the rock slabs look like soft extruded clay, and the water over them is a glossy rubbery sheet with blobby highlights; there is no wet line, foam or crust where water meets rock
issues.fix: give the rock sharp fracture edges and grain, and give the shallow water transparency, a wet darkening band and mineral crust at the waterline

issues.where: the two rock arches in the steaming crater
issues.what: the arches look like smooth clay tubes, all one material with soft rounded forms and no fracture or layering, unlike the strata in the crater wall behind them
issues.fix: break up the arch forms with bedding, cracks and erosion, and match them to the layered wall rock

issues.where: the bench rock in the foreground right, crop x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%
issues.what: the rock texture is stretched into long smeared streaks across the surface, so the UV stretching shows at close range
issues.fix: reproject or triplanar-map the rock texture so it keeps its scale on the slope

issues.where: the ripples around the feet and muzzle fringes of the drinking animals
issues.what: each contact makes perfect concentric rings of the same spacing, so the water looks procedural; the ripples also do not break the reflections
issues.fix: vary the ripple amplitude and spacing, let the rings interfere and decay, and distort the reflections they cross

issues.where: the herd in the shallows, crop x 0 to 17%, y 25 to 42%
issues.what: the animals share near-identical poses and a smooth, uniform model look, several look semi-transparent or ghosted against the glare, and they carry no wet, salt or mud on the legs
issues.fix: vary pose, gait and scale, fix the opacity, and add wet darkening and mud on the lower legs

issues.where: the steam over the crater and the fume plumes on the left horizon
issues.what: the steam is mostly a flat grey tint with little internal light or shape, and the sunlit plumes do not scatter warm light
issues.fix: add volumetric density variation and forward scattering from the low sun

issues.where: the arch rock in the fog, crop x 83 to 100%, y 25 to 42%
issues.what: the rock surface is soft and low in detail, like a blurred texture rather than depth haze
issues.fix: keep the micro detail in the rock and let the fog reduce contrast instead of resolution

issues.where: the loose fringe strands lying on the ground left of the carcass
issues.what: the strands sit on the ground like a flat card, with no contact shadow and no link to the body
issues.fix: attach the strands to the carcass, or give them thickness and contact shadows
